name: Sorafenib
indications_original: Sorafenib tablets are a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of • Unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma ( 1.1 ) • Advanced renal cell carcinoma ( 1.2 ) • Locally recurrent or metastatic, progressive, differentiated thyroid carcinoma (DTC) refractory to radioactive iodine treatment ( 1.3 )
contraindications_original: The recommended dosage is 400 mg orally twice daily without food. ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Sorafenib Tablets are supplied as 200 mg, round biconvex, red film-coated tablets, debossed with "F11" on one side and plain on the other side.
                  Bottles of 30                                           NDC 13668-682-30
                  Bottles of 60                                           NDC 13668-682-60
                  Bottles of 120                                         NDC 13668-682-12
                  100 (10×10) unit-dose tablets                 NDC 13668-682-74
                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F); excursions permitted between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Store in a dry place.
